g.text: such that the VOUT - Schotktky's Vf = 3.300V

g.desc: such that the VOUT - Schotktky's Vf = 3.300V

g.text: It can't go below 3.300V. It can be above,

g.desc: It can't go below 3.300V. It can be above,

g.text: but it's less nice if I hotplug USB.

g.desc: but it's less nice if I hotplug USB.

g.text: Main 3V3 LDO, provides up to 500mA (enough for WiFi)

g.desc: Main 3V3 LDO, provides up to 500mA (enough for WiFi)

g.text: Be careful with ADC tempo noise!

g.desc: Be careful with ADC tempo noise!

g.text: Set to LDO output strictly more than 3.3V

g.desc: Set to LDO output strictly more than 3.3V

g.text: The schotky drops 550mV which wins over

g.desc: The schotky drops 550mV which wins over

g.text: When externally powered + USB powered, this means the

g.desc: When externally powered + USB powered, this means the

g.text: USB power loses and the ext takes over.

g.desc: USB power loses and the ext takes over.

g.text: The fuse is not going to be added initially,

g.desc: The fuse is not going to be added initially,

g.text: but to not refab I provision in.

g.desc: but to not refab I provision in.

g.text: right ESR, but if it doesn't

g.desc: right ESR, but if it doesn't

g.text: try in the 0.5-2 Ω range with scope

g.desc: try in the 0.5-2 Ω range with scope

g.text: 3V3 is high, but S3_VBUS os floating.

g.desc: 3V3 is high, but S3_VBUS os floating.

g.text: This makes the S3's LDO see a reverse voltage

g.desc: This makes the S3's LDO see a reverse voltage

g.text: This diode sets the VBUS = 3.3V so there is almost

g.desc: This diode sets the VBUS = 3.3V so there is almost

g.text: no reverse voltage through it protecting it

g.desc: no reverse voltage through it protecting it

g.text: S3 VBUS is +5V. The diode reverse bias and S3 VBUS 5V

g.desc: S3 VBUS is +5V. The diode reverse bias and S3 VBUS 5V

g.text: is isolated so it doesn't try to power the 5V rail from the USB.

g.desc: is isolated so it doesn't try to power the 5V rail from the USB.

g.text: 3.3V is driven by the S3's LDO, but the 5V board rail is not powered,

g.desc: 3.3V is driven by the S3's LDO, but the 5V board rail is not powered,

g.text: and the S3 VBUS is not driving anything.

g.desc: and the S3 VBUS is not driving anything.
